description: Full WIPO Pearl record for one concept_id: validated equivalents by language, each with reliability rating, defining context, usage note and source. WIPO's lookup-by-id route has answered HTTP 500 for every id since at least 2026-11-10 (unavailable upstream as of 2026-11-21), so pass `term` (the headword) and the record is read from the search route instead; without `term` the call fails with that explanation. pearl_search_terms already returns the same equivalents inline. Example: pearl_concept({ concept_id: "8809643", term: "interleukin" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional. Pipeworx supplies a WIPO Business Partner Portal credential automatically. Pass your own as JSON: '{"client_id":"...","client_secret":"..."}' to use a dedicated subscription instead.

concept_id.description: The record id returned by pearl_search_terms, e.g. "8818607".

lang_code.description: Optional: restrict the record to one ISO 639-1 language (AR, DE, EN, ES, FR, JA, KO, PT, RU, ZH).

term.description: The record's headword, e.g. "interleukin". Needed because WIPO's lookup-by-id route is down: with it the record is read from the search route.

name: pearl_concept
title: Pearl Concept
